function.arguments: {"index": 1, "status": "dismissed", "resolution": "The removal of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 was initially applied to protect baseline mean estimates, but for the response fraction calculation, the 'responded' outcome is independent of the baseline biomarker. Patients with missing baseline biomarker data (due to QC failure) may still have valid response status at week 12. Therefore, excluding them alters the denominator and violates the requirement to report the fraction among all treatment arm patients. The correct approach is to include all treatment arm patients, regardless of baseline biomarker quality, to reflect the full population. The initial removal was an over-correction for a purpose that does not apply here."}
function.name: resolve_finding
